title: Peel, Don't Whack: Partial Coverage, Imperfect Validators, and Intervention Based Shortcut Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Without group labels, shortcut mitigation increasingly relies on interventions : label-preserving edits, such as background or watermark replacement, that are proposed automatically and accepted by a validator. Invariance to a complete family of valid edits yields robustness, but in practice coverage is partial and validators err.   We analyze both in a stylized linear model. For the population logistic solution and the max-margin limit of gradient descent, the decision on every shortcut-flip group follows one additive rule. Hence worst-group accuracy never decreases with coverage, while individual groups can provably degrade, a mechanism for the Whac-a-Mole effect; full coverage is not always needed. In the logistic regime the validator's false-accept rate must stay below a closed-form tolerance that grows with coverage. translated_title: 剥离，而非打地鼠：部分覆盖、不完美验证器与基于干预的捷径缓解
translated_abstract: 在没有组标签的情况下，捷径缓解越来越依赖于干预手段：即自动提出并由验证器接受的保持标签不变的编辑，例如背景或水印替换。对一整族有效编辑的不变性能够带来鲁棒性，但在实践中覆盖往往是部分的，且验证器也会出错。我们在一个风格化的线性模型中对这两者进行分析。对于总体逻辑斯蒂解和梯度下降的最大间隔极限，每个捷径翻转组上的决策都遵循同一个加性规则。因此，最差组准确率随覆盖度单调不减，而个别组却可以被证明会退化——这正是“打地鼠”效应的一种机制；也就是说，并不总是需要完全覆盖。在逻辑斯蒂情形下，验证器的误接受率必须保持在随覆盖度增长的一个闭式容差之下。当训练数据无噪声时，仅仅一次误接受就可能使最大间隔解忽略核心特征。在该模型中，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文在风格化线性模型中证明：在基于干预的捷径缓解中，最差组准确率随覆盖度单调不减、无需完全覆盖，但个别组可能退化（打地鼠效应的机制），且验证器一次误接受就足以让最大间隔解忽略核心特征。
en_tdlr: Using a stylized linear model, the paper proves that for intervention-based shortcut mitigation, worst-group accuracy is monotone in coverage so full coverage is not always needed, yet individual groups can degrade (the Whac-A-Mole mechanism), and a single validator false accept can make the max-margin solution ignore the core feature.
